register: mu da hɔ, anigye, na ɛnyɛ den sɛnea yebetumi
title: Kasa ahorow fi he?
invitation: Hu kasa abusua dua a ɛwɔ Gef adesua kasa 104 no nyinaa akyi, ne kasa abakɔsɛm afã a ɛrentumi nhyɛ dua baako mu yiye no.
summary: Kasa ahorow nya nhyehyɛe fi kasa dedaw mu, gye nsɛm fi wɔn a wɔbɛn wɔn hɔ, tu ne nnipa, na ɛsesa bere a mpɔtamfo yɛ kasa ahorow ne gyinapɛn foforo. Adesua yi de Gef kasa 104 no nyinaa to map so a ɛmfa abusua, asase, nkyerɛwde ne amammuisɛm mmɔ mu.

localization_keys.completion_title: Dua no yɛ abakɔsɛm, ɛnyɛ gyinabea

atlas_labels.title: Gef kasa abusua atlas
atlas_labels.description: Kasa adesua biara a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren pue pɛnkoro pɛ. Nkyerɛwde, mantam, transliteration anaa akenkan mmoa ahorow nyɛ kasa foforo. Wɔkyerɛ nkitahodi kasa no wɔ baabi foforo efisɛ ɔwofo baa baako ntumi nkyerɛ sɛnea wɔbae no yiye.
atlas_labels.accessibility_label: Kasa abusua atlas a Gef adesua kasa 104 no nyinaa wom

notes.atlantic_congo: Din kɛse bi a yɛde ahwɛyiye di dwuma ma Gef kasa a wɔakyerɛ wɔ ha. Niger-Congo nso yɛ din a wɔtaa de di dwuma; nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ mu wɔ gyinabea kɛse no nyinaa nni ahotoso pɛpɛɛpɛ.
notes.basque: Wobu Basque sɛ kasa a ɛwɔ nko efisɛ ntotoho kwan no nnkyerɛɛ abusua kɛse foforo a efi mu bae.

atlas_labels.contact_note: Wɔde wɔn bom sɛnea wɔn abakɔsɛm bae, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn wɔ ɔwofo baa baako ase. Wɔn nkɔso kyerɛ kasa pii ntam nkitahodi a emu yɛ den ne mpɔtamfo adebɔ.

blocks.title: Kasa biara wɔ n'agyanom
blocks.text: Wɔnyɛ kasa pɛnkoro. Mmofra sua kasa fi afoforo hɔ; awo ntoatoaso biara sesa nnyigyei ne kasa mmara kakra; nnipa kuw tu na wohyia; nsɛmfua nso ne wɔn kɔ. Mfeha pii mu no, kasa dedaw bi betumi apaapae ayɛ kasa foforo pii. Ebi yɛ abusua a wɔbɛn, ebi wɔ akyirikyiri, na ebi yɛ afipamfo ara. Gef wɔ adesua kasa 104 mprempren; adesua yi ne map a ɛwɔ map no akyi.

blocks.title: Kasa abusua fa ade a wɔde fi agyanom hɔ ho
blocks.text: Abakɔsɛm kasa ho abenfo toto nnyigyei a ɛsesae daa, nsɛmfua titiriw, asɛmfua nhyehyɛe ne kasa mmara ho de hwɛ sɛ ɛfiri agya baako hɔ anaa. Asɛmfua baako a ɛte sɛ foforo nko ara nnɔɔso, efisɛ kasa taa gye ade fi wɔn ho wɔn ho. Enti English yɛ Germanic, Persian yɛ Indo-European, Arabic yɛ Afro-Asiatic, na Vietnamese yɛ Austroasiatic. Abusua kyerɛ nea efi mu bae, ɛnyɛ ɔman, abusua, nkyerɛwde anaa animuonyam.

blocks.title: Gef kasa abusua atlas
blocks.description: Adesua kasa 104 a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren no mu biara pue pɛnkoro pɛ.

blocks.title: Indo-European: abusua kɛse wɔ nsase pii so
blocks.text: Gef adesua kasa a ɛwɔ hɔ mprempren mu boro fa yɛ Indo-European. Germanic, Romance, Slavic, Baltic ne Celtic baa ahorow wɔ Europe; Indo-Aryan ne Iranian baa ahorow kɔ Asia Anaafo ne Anaafo-atɔe mu. Greek gyina Hellenic baa no ananmu; Armenian ne Albanian wɔ wɔn ankasa baa titiriw. Hindi ne English yɛ abusua a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri; Arabic ne Persian nyɛ saa.

blocks.title: Asia Apuei ne Anaafo-Apuei: afipamfo nyɛ abusua bere nyinaa
blocks.text: Mandarin Chinese ne Cantonese yɛ Sinitic kasa wɔ Sino-Tibetan abusua mu; Burmese wɔ abusua kɛse koro no baa foforo mu. Japanese yɛ Japonic, Korean yɛ Koreanic. Chinese nkyerɛwde ne nsɛmfua anya wɔn baanu so tumi kɛse, nanso tumi a obi anya wo so nsesa nea wufi mu bae. Vietnamese ne Khmer yɛ Austroasiatic; Thai, Lao ne Shan yɛ Tai kasa wɔ Kra-Dai mu. Abusua dua kyerɛ mfiase; nkitahodi map kyerɛ wɔn ntam nkɔmmɔ.

blocks.title: Asia Atɔe ne Mfinimfini: dua pii a wɔabɔ mu
blocks.text: Gef Turkic kasa ne Turkish, Azerbaijani, Bashkir, Chuvash, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Turkmen ne Uzbek. Mongolian yɛ Mongolic, ɛnyɛ Turkic. Adwene dedaw a ɛka Turkic ne Mongolic abusua bom sɛ “Altaic” abusua baako no yɛ nea wɔda so gye ho akyinnye; Gef nkyerɛkyerɛ no sɛ abusua nhyehyɛe a wɔagye atom. Estonian, Finnish ne Hungarian yɛ Uralic. Wɔ Caucasus no, Georgian yɛ Kartvelian, Armenian yɛ Indo-European, Azerbaijani yɛ Turkic.

blocks.title: Afrika ne Mfinimfini Apuei: nsonsonoe kɛse wɔ din a yenim akyi
blocks.text: Wɔ Afro-Asiatic abusua mu no, Arabic, Hebrew, Amharic ne Tigrinya yɛ Semitic; Hausa yɛ Chadic; Somali ne Oromo yɛ Cushitic. Gef kyerɛ Swahili, Akan, Igbo, Yoruba ne Zulu wɔ Atlantic-Congo nhyehyɛe kɛse mu a ɛde ahwɛyiye ka nkyekyɛmu kɛse ho. Afrika wɔ kasa abusua ne kasa a ɛwɔ nko pii sen nea Gef kyerɛ mprempren.

blocks.title: Austronesian: abusua a wɔatrɛw wɔ po so wiase
blocks.text: Indonesian, Malay, Javanese, Filipino ne Hawaiian yɛ Austronesian. Po so akwantu, atuo, aguadi, aware, atenae, sukuu ne aban nhyehyɛe boa kyerɛ baabi a wɔka wɔn mprempren. Kasa din a wɔde wɔ product mu no ne abusua dua mu baa a ɛwɔ akyiri nyɛ ade koro: Indonesian ne Malay yɛ gyinapɛn abusua a wɔbɛn paa; Hawaiian wɔ akyirikyiri kɛse wɔ abusua kɛse koro no mu.

blocks.title: Asia Anaafo wɔ abusua kɛse boro baako
blocks.text: Gef kasa pii wɔ Asia Anaafo atifi fam yɛ Indo-Aryan, enti wɔyɛ Indo-European. Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam ne Kannada wɔ Dravidian abusua soronko mu. Mfeha pii nkitahodi ama wɔnanya nsɛmfua a wɔagye ne mantam suban a wɔbom kyɛ a ɛnsɛee wɔn mfiase soronko. “India kasa” kyerɛ asase anaa ɔman mu nsɛm, ɛnyɛ kasa abusua baako.

blocks.title: Abusua nketewa ne kasa a ɛwɔ nko nso wɔ abakɔsɛm a edi mu
blocks.text: Quechua yɛ Quechuan, Georgian yɛ Kartvelian, Mongolian yɛ Mongolic, Japanese yɛ Japonic, na Korean yɛ Koreanic. Sɛ Gef wɔ kasa baako pɛ fi abusua bi mu a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ abusua no ho nhia. Wobu Basque sɛ kasa a ɛwɔ nko efisɛ wɔnnkyerɛɛ abusua kɛse foforo a ɛfiri mu bae yiye. Kasa a ɛwɔ nko nkyerɛ kasa a ɛyɛ tete anaa nea ɛnnya nkɔso.

blocks.title: Abakɔsɛm bi ye sɛ wɔkyerɛ sɛ network
blocks.text: Nigerian Pidgin ne Haitian Creole bae wɔ kasa pii ntam nkitahodi a emu yɛ den mu. English ne Nigerian Pidgin nsɛmfua abakɔsɛm fibea titiriw, na French ne Haitian Creole de, nanso wɔn baanu nyinaa kyerɛ mpɔtamfo a wɔyɛɛ wɔn no nhyehyɛe, wɔn ho nimdeɛ, adebɔ ne kasa foforo. Enti Gef de wɔn hyɛ nkitahodi abakɔsɛm ase, na ɛmfa wɔn nhyɛ ɔwofo baa baako ase.

blocks.title: Nkyerɛwde betumi adaadaa ani
blocks.text: Nkyerɛwde nhyehyɛe yɛ mfiridwuma; kasa abusua yɛ abusua nhyehyɛe. Kasa a wɔnyɛ abusua betumi de nkyerɛwde koro adi dwuma, na abusua kasa betumi de nkyerɛwde soronko adi dwuma. Arabic, Persian, Urdu ne Sorani Kurdish de nkyerɛwde a ɛfiri Arabic di dwuma, nanso Arabic yɛ Afro-Asiatic na afoforo yɛ Indo-European. Wobetumi akyerɛw Serbian wɔ Cyrillic anaa Latin mu. Wɔ Gef mu no, nkyerɛwde, transliteration ne akenkan mmoa ahorow ntɔ 104 no so.

blocks.title: Dɛn nti na kasa tu, paapae, fra na gye ade?
blocks.text: Aguadi, ahemman, ɔsom, atuo, nkurow, sukuu, media ne aban sesa kasa asase so mfonini. Kasa trɛw nyinaa mma asomdwoe mu: atuo a wɔhyɛ, nkoa, nkonimdi, kolonialisɛm, nhyehyɛe a ɛhyɛ nnipa ma wɔgye kasa foforo ne mpɔtamfo mmɔden a wɔbɔ de kora wɔn kasa anaa ma ɛsan yɛ den nyinaa yɛ abakɔsɛm fã. Nnipa na wɔwɔ map so nsensanee biara akyi.

blocks.title: Kasa baako wie he na foforo fi he?
blocks.text: Abusua nhyehyɛe kyerɛ abakɔsɛm mu abusuabɔ, nanso ɛno nko ara ntumi nsii nnɛ kasa din ho gyinae. Nhoma, adesua, ahyehyɛde, abusua din, amammui, nkyerɛw gyinapɛn ne sɛnea wɔn a wɔka kasa no nim wɔn ho nso ho hia. Bosnian, Croatian ne Serbian yɛ South Slavic gyinapɛn a wɔbɛn paa nanso wɔyɛ nnɛ kasa din soronko wɔ Gef mu. Bokmål ne Nynorsk yɛ Norwegian nkyerɛw gyinapɛn abien. Hindi ne Urdu kyɛ kasa mfiase a wɔbɛn paa, nanso nkyerɛwde, kasa gyinapɛn ne amammerɛ abakɔsɛm betumi ayɛ soronko.

blocks.title: Yɛyɛ dɛn hu agyanom a obiara annkyere wɔn kasa?
blocks.text: Abakɔsɛm kasa ho abenfo de ntotoho kwan di dwuma. Wɔtoto kasa ho, hwehwɛ nnyigyei a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nsɛ daa ne kasa mmara a wɔbom kyɛ, na wɔsan si suban a ɛkyerɛ wɔn mma kasa yiye. Asɛmfua baako a ɛte sɛ foforo kɛse yɛ adanse a ɛyɛ mmerɛw; nhyehyɛe a ɛsan ba wɔ nsɛmfua titiriw ne kasa nhyehyɛe pii mu yɛ den. Agya kasa a wɔasan asi no frɛ no proto-language. Proto-Indo-European yɛ nyansahu mu san-si, ɛnyɛ nnyigyei a wɔkyeree. Dodow a yɛkɔ akyiri wɔ abakɔsɛm mu no, dodow no ara na ahotoso so tew.

blocks.title: Dua no yɛ abakɔsɛm, ɛnyɛ gyinabea
blocks.description: Afei wo wɔ map a ɛwɔ map no akyi: kasa 104, abusua pii, ne nkitahodi abakɔsɛm a ɛtɔ da a network kyerɛ no yiye sen dua. Abusua nkyerɛ sɛ kasa bi ye, ho tew, yɛ mmerɛw anaa ho hia sen foforo. Sɛ kasa abien te sɛ wɔn ho a, bisa: wɔnyaa ade fi agya koro hɔ anaa abakɔsɛm mu nkitahodi?
